Posted March 28, 2005
Analysis by Richard Cowan

(MarijuanaNews note: I have said that I am not very optimistic about the Court doing the right thing.
See
We Have Already Won A Lot From The Supreme Court Case, Which Is Good Because That Is Probably All That We Are Going To Get. DEA Changes The Rules on Treating Pain.

Ironically, this just happens to be the week that NORML is having its annual conference in San Francisco. That is good, except that all of the staff will be out of Washington when the phones start ringing, but they will be in the right place for the news.

Whatever happens, the fight will go on. If we lose, there will be even more pressure on the politicians who will have to start listening to the voters and not just the police lobby.

The press release below demonstrates just how utterly pathetic the prohibitionist hardliners really are. MarijuanaNews readers will be familiar with the group, the Drug Free America Foundation.
See
 Prohibitionist Propaganda Organization Issues Press Release
Offering Their " Expert Opinion " On The Appeals Court Oakland Ruling
and
 Prohibitionist Organization Has Money To Burn On Press Release About How It Is Politically Incorrect To Refer To A " Marijuana " Transdermal Patch
and
 What the Prohibitionists Are Saying About Medical Marijuana. Briefs Filed In Opposition to Medical Necessity Defense. 3 Items. Have Your Anti-Emetics Handy.

Also, it should be noted that this group was founded by Mel Sembler, Bush's ambassador to Italy. He is a major Republican contributor, and the founder of the notorious Straight, Inc.
See
 Conference On Rehab Racketeers Tied To Bush Will Raise Important Issues: Saving Children From Drug Treatment Abuse. Saving DEAland from Drug War Lite. A Conference That Should Embarrass Washington.

I hope the media will talk to these people and check out their track record. Even a novice to the issue should notice that they lie about what we are saying, but we want everyone to know the prohibitionist party line and quote the prohibitionists own words.)

Drug Free America Foundation Available for Comment When Supreme Court 'Medical' Marijuana Decision is Announced
Fri Mar 25, 8:00 AM ET

To: Assignment Desk, Daybook Editor

Contact: Lana Beck of Drug Free America Foundation, 727-828-0211 or 727-403-7571 (cell); Web: http://www.dfaf.org

News Advisory:

The Supreme Court decision in the so-called medical marijuana case (Raich v. Ashcroft) is expected on Tuesday or Wednesday of next week.

Drug Free America Foundation's Executive Director, Calvina Fay, will be available for comment when the decision is announced. Drug Free America Foundation also has other drug policy experts (physicians, lawyers and parents) available for interviews.

They include:

David Evans, Esq. -- Special Advisor, Drug Free America Foundation

Robert DuPont, -- Former Director of National Institute on Drug Abuse
See
 Former Head Of NIDA Sort of Calls For Medical Marijuana Tests in Washington Post Op-ed.
Taking Care Of the Prohibitionist Party Line. Not the Patients.

Eric Voth, M.D. -- Chairman of the Institute on Global Drug Policy
See
 Chairman of the International Drug Strategy Institute Lies To Local Paper As Well As Internationally.
and
 The Prohibitionist True Believers Explain What The IOM Report Said -- " Marijuana Causes Health Problems "
and
 Classic Reefer Madness from Drug Watch International:
" MARIJUANA USED BY JONESBORO KILLERS "!

Bob Peterson -- Former Michigan State Drug Czar and Vice President, PRIDE Youth Programs
See
 Hyper-Lying: Walters Takes War Propaganda to A New Level: " Marijuana is two-thirds of the addiction problem in America today.

Joyce Nalepka -- President of Drug Free Kids: America's Challenge

To arrange an interview with Fay or any of our other experts, contact Lana Beck, Director of Communications for Drug Free America Foundation, at (727) 828-0211 or (727) 403-7571.

Drug Free America Foundation is the leading opponent of what we call medical-fraud marijuana.

With over 20 years experience in the drug policy field, Fay maintains: " There is no valid medical use for raw (smoked) marijuana. Proponents cynically exploit the terminally ill to perpetrate a hoax. Their goal is back-door legalization of a dangerous, addictive substance. "
See
 The First Anniversary of the IOM Report And The Lies and Hatred Continue, Business As Usual. Analysis By Richard Cowan

Founded in 1995, Drug Free America Foundation is dedicated to fighting drug use, drug addiction and drug trafficking and to promoting effective drug policies, education and prevention. It is equally committed to exposing the distortions and misrepresentations of legalizers and their deceptive tactics, including medical fraud marijuana. More information is available on our website: http://www.dfaf.org
